'''Tallpeak''' was a small settlement located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Giaca]], which served as the primary outpost of the [[Peroenian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the world. It usually housed a population of just a few hundred individuals.<ref name="TUR" />
